006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * FOCA: Exceptions related to type casting.
014 */
015public class CastFunctionException
016    extends FunctionMetapathError {
017  @NonNull
018  private static final String PREFIX = "FOCA";
019  /**
020   * <a href=
021   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOCA0002">err:FOCA0002</a>:
022   * Raised by fn:resolve-QName and fn:QName when a supplied value does not have
023   * the lexical form of a QName or URI respectively; and when casting to decimal,
024   * if the supplied value is NaN or Infinity.
025   */
026  public static final int INVALID_LEXICAL_VALUE = 2;
027
028  /**
029   * <a href=
030   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOCA0003">err:FOCA0003</a>:
031   * Raised when casting to xs:integer if the supplied value exceeds the
032   * implementation-defined limits for the datatype.
033   */
034  public static final int INPUT_VALUE_TOO_LARGE = 3;
035
036  /**
037   * the serial version UUID.
038   */
039  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
040
041  /**
042   * The atomic item that could not be cast to the target type.
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  private final IAnyAtomicItem item;
046
047  /**
048   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code item}, and
049   * no cause.
050   *
051   * @param code
052   *          the error code value
053   * @param item
054   *          the item the exception applies to
055   * @param message
056   *          the exception message text
057   */
058  public CastFunctionException(int code, @NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item, String message) {
059    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
060    this.item = item;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code item}, and
065   * {@code cause}.
066   *
067   * @param code
068   *          the error code value
069   * @param item
070   *          the item the exception applies to
071   * @param message
072   *          the exception message text
073   * @param cause
074   *          the original exception cause
075   */
076  public CastFunctionException(int code, @NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item, String message, Throwable cause) {
077    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
078    this.item = item;
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Get the item associated with the exception.
083   *
084   * @return the associated item
085   */
086  @NonNull
087  public IAnyAtomicItem getItem() {
088    return item;
089  }
090}
